description: Call any WasapFlow Bridge endpoint not covered by the other tools (see bridge_docs_search for paths). Irreversible endpoints need {"confirm": true} in the body. Confirm with the user before any call that sends, deletes or changes something.

body.description: Optional JSON body. Send endpoints accept biz_opaque_callback_data (your reference, max 512 chars).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header for send endpoints (POST /messages/*, POST /broadcasts).

name: bridge_call_api
title: Call any Bridge API endpoint
